div.p: This case-sensitive code system https://fhir-ig.digitalhealth.gov.ng/CodeSystem/ng-hiv-transfer-reason-cs defines the following codes:

tr.td: The client is relocating from the area served by the transferring facility.
The receiving facility is more conveniently located for the client.
The client independently requested or initiated transfer to another treatment site.
The client is transferring because of experienced or anticipated HIV-related stigma.
The client is transferring for prevention of mother-to-child transmission services.
